name: Detección de Patrones de Repetición
description: Detecta excessive patrón repetition characteristic of generado por IA text.
useCase: Identifying AI text through repetition análisis
mechanism: Analiza micro-patrón frequency para detectar excessive repetition. AI text generators tend to reuse sentence structures and phrases more than human writers.
source: Krishna et al. (2024) - Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Krishna et al. (2024) - Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text
Holtzman, A. et al. (2020). The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration. ICLR.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
